assessment: contact620 passes the recorded 0.3m/s casewise traversal gate and strongly improves hard570; retain as an interim adaptation candidate. Two standard narrow-tread stalls, residual descending leg contact, seven worsening action/jerk cases and missing per-env orientation records prevent blanket smoothness or causal-contact-reward claims.

scope.gate: final traversal requires >=0.95 completion in every case/seed, <=0.05 each failure category, and zero history base-contact environments; 31/32 passes, 30/32 fails
scope.sampling: first episodes captured before autoreset; ordinary motion aggregates exclude first second
scope.metric_averaging: equal arithmetic mean of three seed-level aggregates per case; group means weight cases equally; not pooled trajectory RMS
scope.failure_flags: nonexclusive flags; unique noncompletions come from completed=False
scope.reset_seed_limitation: reset seeds do not resample startup terrain/material/dynamics

hard570_low_stair_failure_evidence.interpretation: positive lateral drift and support/lane loss affect late low-stair traversal, including goal-platform approach; endpoint geometry alone does not identify a collision mechanism

hard520.scope: sparse 0.1s traces of one environment per case and reset seed, active first episode after first second; never full 32-environment contact statistics or contact duration

hard570.scope: sparse 0.1s traces of one environment per case and reset seed, active first episode after first second; never full 32-environment contact statistics or contact duration

contact620.scope: sparse 0.1s traces of one environment per case and reset seed, active first episode after first second; never full 32-environment contact statistics or contact duration

contact_metric_limitations: Any calf/thigh/shank contact step fraction measures existence, not body count, sustained scraping duration, severity or damage.
History3 at physics5ms retains ages0/5/10ms at policy20ms and can omit first-substep-only impacts.
Current contact uses latest net-normal-force vector norm at policy boundary; it includes horizontal riser normals but no tangential friction force.
Slip metrics use world-horizontal foot-link speed, not actual contact-point tangential slip; current/history denominators differ.
Sparse per-body traces cover one environment percase/seed; they validate attribution but do not replace all-env aggregate metrics.
Motion improvement flag only checks pause threshold and is not a smoothness certificate.
Early termination changes measured trajectories; lower whole-case jerk/action/contact values can reflect different traversed portions.

independent_force_review.scope: Independent CPU read of all three raw new reports; no source changes or GPU rollout
checks: each body history peak at least current
per-row maximum across selected bodies equals corresponding aggregate current/history shank force
